How it works

# Be present. The notes take care of themselves.
TicNote records, transcribes, and turns conversations into summaries you can search.


- 
01 Capture

## Capture
Record meetings, lectures, and calls on the card or earbuds.
- 
02 Understand

## Understand
Transcription in 120+ languages, summaries and mind maps in the app.
- 
03 Act

## Act
Ask the recording questions and pull out action items.
Eligible hardware includes 600 transcription minutes per month. Unbound free accounts include 300 minutes per month. Pro plans add more, for example 2,100 minutes per month on 1-Year Pro listings. See Pro plan and languages.
